scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix frontend ci && node scripts/backend.mjs sync --locked
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others --names API,UI --prefix-colors cyan,green "node scripts/backend.mjs run fastapi dev main.py" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:ui
scripts.test:ui: npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run format:check
